acceptance: A PK-only tuned ClickHouse run records the key-derived CREATE TABLE and reconciliation drops nothing for primary_keys.
The ClickHouse introspector reports PRIMARY KEY facts from system.tables.primary_key and declares PRIMARY KEY in constraint_types.
Liveness matrix chDB auto cells reach applied_verified in CI; tuned chDB cells still reach applied_verified.
context: Found by the real-CLI liveness gate (#3085), which pinned chDB auto at applied_unverified. Owner decision relayed by the coordinator 2026-10-17: record the key-based ordering as evidence so auto runs verify.
description: Owner-approved 2026-10-17. With --tuning auto, chDB is asked only for primary keys. ClickHouse renders them as the MergeTree ORDER BY derived from the declared key, but the ledger records only tuned sort/partition DDL, so the primary-key intent has no evidence, is dropped ("adapter rendered no statement"), and auto runs stay applied_unverified. Change: when tuning is enabled and primary keys are requested, record the executed CREATE TABLE whose ORDER BY comes from the declared primary key; teach the ClickHouse introspector to read system.tables.primary_key and report PRIMARY KEY constraint facts so the statement's sort-key and primary-key intents corroborate. Pin the chDB auto cells of the real-CLI liveness matrix at applied_verified.
